# StrokeStyle

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

How a path is outlined.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

## Properties

- [`dashOffset`](#dashoffset): Distance into the dash pattern at which the line starts, in points.
- [`dashPattern`](#dashpattern): Alternating dash and gap lengths, in points.
- [`lineCap`](#linecap): How line ends are drawn (default `'butt'`).
- [`lineJoin`](#linejoin): How corners are drawn (default `'miter'`).
- [`miterLimit`](#miterlimit): Ratio at which a mitred corner is cut to a bevel.
- [`paint`](#paint): The colour or gradient of the stroke.
- [`width`](#width): Stroke width, in points.
